bur-battleaxe-logging-rr.st: By 1922 it was a 34-mile Northern Pacific branch from Washburn to Iron River, acquired about 1902. In April 1922 the Interstate Commerce Commission let the NP abandon and tear up 'the Washburn-Iron River branch... known as the Battle Axe'; Bayfield County and the state fought it, but a federal judge denied the state's motion in June 1922. The track was presumably removed in 1922-23.
src: Superior Evening Telegram, 22 Apr 1922, p. 7 (Newspapers.com image 1240350237)
